notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi adventurers!
We have great news today — we're finally sharing the early access release date for Runeborn!

It will be available on October 9th for a base price of $13.99 USD | €13.99 | £11.99, with a nice launch discount! 👀

Check out the release date trailer:
[previewyoutube="8Xu9ZB-tw7I;full"][/previewyoutube]
What’s in the Early Access version?
Malakar Boss Fight Editions (Challenge Modifiers)

Endless Mode

Seeded Runs

New Achievements

2 New Books

New Trinkets

New Scrolls

New Amulets and Auras

New Bosses, Elites and Minions

Shop Updates

Visual and Sound Improvements

We already have a clear vision of what’s in store throughout Early Access and will share a roadmap with you all on launch day — so keep an eye out for it!

We can’t wait for you to dive into this Early Access version, share your feedback here on Steam or on the game’s Discord server, and help us iterate as much as possible leading up to version 1.0 and beyond!


Wishlist now and get notified at launch!

notes.title: June Update – Global Localization, Steam Deck Support & Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers!
We’re back with another big update for the Runeborn demo (0.5)—and this one’s all about opening the gates to more players, improving the experience, and making each run feel better paced and more rewarding. Let’s dive in!


🌍 Now Localized in 10 Languages!
Runeborn is now playable in nine additional languages:
Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Spanish.


 We worked with professional translators for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese to ensure high-quality localization.


 The remaining languages were translated using machine translation and AI assistance. While we’ve done our best to polish them, they might not be perfect—please let us know if you spot anything off!


We’re also officially launching in Asian markets on June 5th, 2025. Welcome to all our new players—we’re thrilled to have you on this journey!


🎮 Partial Steam Deck & Controller Support
 You asked, we listened. Runeborn now has partial controller support for Xbox, PlayStation, and other modern gamepads. 

 It also runs great on Steam Deck so you can take your roguelike deckbuilding on the go.

🎥 Updated Launch Trailer
To celebrate all the improvements and our global rollout, we’ve released a brand-new launch trailer!  It features updated gameplay and new trinket art—perfect for sharing with a friend who’s curious about the game.


[previewyoutube="K2Gfc3kjURQ;full"][/previewyoutube]
Let us know what you think—we’re proud of how far Runeborn has come!


📅 Coming to Steam Next Fest – June 9th
 We’re excited to announce that Runeborn will be part of Steam Next Fest, starting June 9th!


 This is your chance to jump into the updated demo, experience all the latest changes, and share your feedback with us.


 We’ll be hanging out during the event, streaming gameplay, answering questions, and talking with the community. Be sure to stop by our store page and join the fun!

🧭 Better Game Flow & Run Length
With the addition of Chapter 3 in Early Access, we noticed that complete runs were starting to feel like a slog, especially once Chapter 4 entered the mix. To keep runs engaging and rewarding:


 Chapters have been shortened from 9 levels to 7.


 This change keeps the pacing tight and lets players reach elite and boss rewards more frequently.


 To compensate, we’ve increased the difficulty of the first three levels, so your journey still starts with a challenge.

🎨 Visual Improvements
 Over 100 trinkets have received updated artwork to better match their theme and rarity.

[img src="https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45193475/fca6a762ef874f4a068d5d825b56b4370a0cfd18.png"]


 Tooltips got a visual facelift, making it easier to quickly parse important info mid-run.

[img src="https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45193475/7ff08e78b80b9d98a8ded16dbfed0b329178cf30.png"]

 And to spice up boss encounters, we’ve added a new effect for each boss—see if you can spot them!


 What we're dubbing "Hot Trinkets" - a new visual way to see how much a Trinket is contributing towards your Cast

[img src="https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45193475/12f12451e573a5665d14d4896991f120e8cba96a.png"]
🐞 Bug Fixes & Patch Notes
 We’ve squashed dozens of bugs and made various under-the-hood improvements.


 Full patch notes are below.

Patch Notes
Summary


 100+ NEW Trinket Art


 Added Localization: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, and Spanish


 Added Basic Controller Support (Virtual Cursor)


 NEW Tooltip Art to improve readability


 Bosses now have additional abilities


 Removed most error popups and implemented error sounds and animations in their place


 Added Trinket Slot Reward animation feedback


 Vypras Forced Hold visuals updated


 Added click to skip cutscenes (Comic, Elite & Boss Intros)

Balance Changes
 Chapters now have 7 levels


 HP Curve updated to account for new Chapter length


 Removed Ghorlock boss from Demo


 Curse of Replication will now target non-Unique trinkets if possible


 Enemy abilities no longer trigger after they die

Trinket Updates
 Jade Bell: Double your Coins gained from Interest (Previously: +1 Coin for every 5 Coins owned when an enemy is defeated (Maximum +10 Coins))


 Gift Box: +2 Coins per Common Trinket you own at the start of a fight (Previously: Conjure 2 Common Trinkets at the start of a fight)


 Nugget of Wisdom: +2 Coins when you deal greater than or equal to 50% of the Enemy's total HP in a single Cast (Previously: +4 Coins when an enemy is defeated)


 Faberge Egg: After 3 more Enemies are defeated, Evolves to make a copy of a random Trinket, including its Gem (Previously: After 3 more Enemies are defeated, sell this to make a copy of a random Trinket, including its Gem)


 Flickering Flame: +50% to all listed Amulet values (Previously: Retrigger all Runes for the next 5 Casts)


 Peg Leg: Degrade value changed from 3 -> 1


 Axe Akimbo: Damage changed from 300 -> 400


 Jeweler's Loupe: xMulti changed from 0.5x -> 0.4x


 Wild Card: Moved from Rare to Legendary


 Ocarina: Now works with Elite and Boss Chests as well


 Frostbite:  Now only activates on Meditate and Cast


 Sigil of Speed: Now starts tracking when you get the trinket rather than from the start of the level (If obtained mid way through a level, you can now still earn the highest rarity trinket)


 Sprinting Shoes: Removed


 Nullification: Removed


 Added a new Duplicate keyword on Trinkets that have been duplicated by Curse of Replication, Faberge Egg

Bug Fixes
 Fixed an issue where changing resolutions in-game caused an error


 Fixed an issue where the end of run jingle was being played as a sound effect, using the incorrect volume slider setting


 Fixed an issue where destroying a trinket slot that was being copied by Chameleon Tail would cause an error


 Fixed an issue where match previews did not work with Double Trouble


 Fixed an issue where Black Ice Amulet did not work with Daoist Bracers


 Fixed an issue where Helping Hand and Avia would cause Wild Runes to morph into their final rune prematurely


 Fixed an issue where Dark Magic would not connect to Wilds


 Fixed an issue where hovering trinkets during a cast would display incorrect values for Grow trinkets


 Fixed an issue where Mobius Scroll Case would work with Forbidden Scrolls that add amulets


 Fixed an issue where Coin sound effects would play on the Game Over Leaderboard Popups


 Fixed an issue where Prismatic Eye, and Skipping Stone would show incorrect match particles when fighting the Siren enemy


 Fixed various issues with Scroll of the Ram


That’s it for now! Whether you’re diving into a new language version, picking up a controller, or testing out a new build during Steam Next Fest, we can’t wait to hear what you think of the changes.

As always, we’d love to hear your feedback in the forums or Discord. Thanks for playing—and stay Runeborn.

- The Runeborn Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.4.0
notes.notes:
Greetings Runeborn!
Another update has arrived! This patch brings multiple UI and clarity improvements, bug reporting enhancements, and more fine-tuning based on your feedback. Spell-line previews are now clearer, bug reporting has been improved with more logging, and we've refined the "Big Win" banner experience. There's also a new option to skip the intro comic, updates to trinket descriptions, and various visual improvements.

Check out the full details below, and don't forget to watch our breakdown of everything in Runeborn Insider 2! 
[previewyoutube=R0uR043aMhg;full][previewyoutube=8pAaVD8m_gg;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Summary

 NEW Rune Hold and Idle animations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/ee57a2e163f88c961b9e97cc67bd957830dd3aee.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193475/0e156a28c4267fe12915e094f015f23fd1360a1c.gif
 NEW Boss and Elite Intro animations
 NEW Acts renamed to Chapters, new Chapters Screen added between Chapters
 NEW BIG NUMBERS! Our underlying systems now support MUCH larger numbers
 Numbers greater than or equal to a Quadrillion are now shown in a shorter form, which can be switched to Scientific Notation in the Gameplay Options
 Unfortunately, this comes at the cost of some precision loss after a certain number of digits
 Shrinking Amulets no longer apply permanent damage changes to your Runes. Replacing or removing a Shrinking Amulet will now revert the temporary damage changes
 Big Win Banners will now be enabled by default. Your Gameplay Setting for Big Win Banners will have reset
 Big Win Banners received a quick sound pass
 Big Win Banner damage requirement thresholds have been increased:
 25% -> 75%
 50% -> 100%
 75% -> 150%
 100% -> 200%
 Bug Reports will now also send over your Settings and any additional errors that we're able to capture that may have occurred during gameplay. So don't be afraid to resubmit Error Reports an additional time after updating to this version
 Increased playback speed of certain Comic panels
 Hovering a Spell Line Indicator (Bookmark) will show you the full pattern. We'll show it again during the scoring sequence
 Updated Trinket Grow and Degrade value positioning to be less confusing when Trinkets start to overlap
 Small animation feedback added to Coin UI when purchases are made / unable to be made
 Small animation feedback added to Hold UI when trying to hold past the hold limit
 Improved Tutorial steps around Spell Lines
 Improved Cast animations when the Casted Elemental Ball is created
 Added Feedback for Trinkets that Reset their values after a fight
 Updated descriptions for both the Boss and the Rune Targeting
 Boss Targeting now happens immediately instead of when you Cast
 Updated the transition of music after an Elite/Boss are defeated
 Updated the colour for the Degrade keyword to clash less with other keywords
 Updated Scroll of the Forge description to be more clear, with an additional side tooltip to explain the thresholds needed to summon specific rarities
 Added an option to disable the Comic after the first time playing
 Removed Coup De Grace Trinket (for now)Fixes
 Fixed an issue where our Font Library was missing accented Latin characters (Thanks to Zérodaim)
 Fixed an issue where Satchel only gave 1 extra Trinket Slot instead of 2 when conjured from Sigil of Speed (Thanks to Pkay)
 Fixed an issue where many Mirror Trinkets caused the game to crash (Thanks to Flimsy)
 Fixed an issue where Black Ice Amulet and Dwarven Firewine showed incorrect Grow values due to Firestarter (Thanks to Flimsy)
 Fixed an issue where you are able to click Use after clicking Cancel during Scroll Usage
 Fixed an issue where hovering the Spell Line Indicators before casting will cause them not to show up during the scoring sequence
 Fixed an issue where the bottom of the Rune Inventory was tough to see, possibly obstructing Amulets
 Fixed an issue where the improper meditate total was displayed after defeating an Elite with Frosty Robe (Thanks to grepthis)
 Fixed an issue where Meditation and Cast Button Tooltip would gradually move down over time, eventually offscreen (Thanks to zBIR0)
 Fixed an issue where the Last Cast Breakdown popup could get stuck on your screen (Thanks to KenKin)
 Fixed an issue where the Mirror and Unique side tooltips would be sorted incorrectly (Thanks to Bicepts)
 Fixed an issue where Trinket unlocks showed incorrect values on the Unlock Screen (Thanks to Archon)
 Fixed various visual issues with Trinket Unlock cards
 Fixed an issue where the Chest images would be missing in the General Shop (Thanks to Flimsy)
 Fixed an issue where the Boss targeting indicator was missing (Thanks to Zérodaim)
 Fixed an issue Brontis wasn’t triggering Recycler animations
 Fixed an issue where the Damage x Multi display would not update on the last trigger or a Trinket, Rune, or Amulet (Thanks to SecretShrek)
 Fixed an issue with Arachnis showing the incorrect match preview upon disabling trinkets that blur matches (Distortion Lens, Lightning Rod, etc) (Thanks to Zérodaim)
 Fixed an issue where conjuring Nullification mid-fight would not disable enemy targeting (Thanks to Flimsy)
 Fixed an issue where Boss Targeting would not target anything if all Runes had amulets (Thanks to Zérodaim)
 Fixed an issue where Thief (part 2) and Recycler were missing Coin feedback (Thanks to Flimsy)
 Fixed an issue where the Line Preview was wrong after continuing a game
 Fixed an issue where Trinkets were not getting “marked as read” in Collections
 Fixed an issue where the Enemies in Collections were not being properly “marked as read”
 Fixed an issue where selling a Faberge Egg with an Amethyst to create a Mirroring Trinket causes errors
 Fixed a hitbox issue with the Sell Display overlapping the Gem Shop Sockets



This update brings even more polish and improvements to Runeborn, thanks to your feedback! Let us know what you think, and we’ll see you in the next update.
